tools.name: create_return
tools.description: Starts a return for one line of a delivered Contoso order and returns the return number (RMA). Confirm the item, quantity and reason with the customer before calling it.

lineNumber.description: Order line to return, as shown by get_order_status, for example 1.

quantity.description: Number of items to return from that line, at least 1.

reason.description: Return reason: Damaged, WrongItem, NotAsDescribed or NoLongerNeeded.

comment.description: Optional details from the customer, for example what is damaged.
